questions.prompt: Which personal goal best shows growth in Religious Education values?
options: I will tell the truth, respect others, serve safely, and care for creation
I will mock others and waste resources
I will help only when praised
I will ignore truth when it is hard
questions.correctAnswer: I will tell the truth, respect others, serve safely, and care for creation
questions.explanation: Religious Education values should guide personal choices at home, school, and in the community.
questions.learningOutcome: Create a personal commitment based on religious and moral values.

questions.prompt: A class wants to start a kindness campaign. Which slogan best fits Religious Education?
options: Serve with respect, speak truth, and include everyone
Laugh at people who are different
questions.correctAnswer: Serve with respect, speak truth, and include everyone
questions.explanation: A strong kindness campaign should encourage service, truthfulness, respect, and inclusion.
questions.learningOutcome: Create simple messages that promote kindness and inclusion.

questions.prompt: Which plan best combines worship, learning, and action after a lesson on peace?
options: Reflect quietly, discuss respectful words, and practise peace at school
Pray and then start a quarrel
questions.correctAnswer: Reflect quietly, discuss respectful words, and practise peace at school
questions.explanation: Religious learning becomes meaningful when reflection leads to peaceful action.
questions.learningOutcome: Create simple action steps that connect religious reflection with daily conduct.
